comparison.objective: Spread butter evenly on fragile bread while holding it still; candidate commissions an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, compliant spreading, and tear avoidance versus recessed-tool engagement, fine collar adjustment, counterholding, locking, and machine cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Evenly butter the slice without tearing it and place the knife off the bread; coverage, force, tear, and spill thresholds are unspecified. Candidate has quantified dynamic and retention criteria.
comparison.reason: Compliant food spreading and fragile-object stabilization do not test mechanical damping adjustment or repeated impact performance.
